BiblicalUsage: Mary and Joseph bring two young pigeons to the temple, the offering of the poor for the firstborn son, as the law commands.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two small birds say everything about how Jesus came: not with the lamb of the rich, but with the pigeons of the poor.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
